items.title: 说明车辆故障
items.prompt: What's the reason for the appointment?
items.hint: 简要描述故障发生的场景、现象和频率，让维修人员能够继续判断。
rubric: 给出一个可追问的细节

items.title: 确认送修时间
items.prompt: How about this Friday? Can you drop off the car before 8:30 a.m. for a tune-up?
items.hint: 确认你是否方便；如果不方便，给出一个明确的替代日期或时间。

items.title: 确认取餐门店
items.prompt: Which Starbucks did you want to place this order at?
items.hint: 说出门店位置，并补充一个能避免选错门店的地标或街道信息。

items.title: 选择披萨配料
items.prompt: Okay, what kind of toppings would you like?
items.hint: 列出想要的配料，并说明是否有不要的配料或饮食限制。

items.title: 描述理想餐厅
items.prompt: Okay, sure, and for the restaurant itself, what should it be like?
items.hint: 从氛围、预算、菜系或位置中选择两项，说明你的具体要求。

items.title: 确认餐桌预订
items.prompt: They have a table available for two to four people at 7 p.m. Should I book it?
items.hint: 确认人数和时间是否合适，再清楚说明是否预订。

items.title: 处理场次售罄
items.prompt: I am really sorry, but this showtime is already sold out. Would you like to see if another time has available tickets?
items.hint: 回应售罄信息，并给出你能接受的新时间范围。
rubric: 说明是否查找其他场次

items.title: 选择更早场次
items.prompt: Would you like to find an earlier session?
items.hint: 说明是否需要更早的场次，并给出最早或最晚可接受的时间。

items.title: 确认接车时间
items.prompt: Sure, and did you want to schedule that for right now to pick you up?
items.hint: 说明现在出发还是预约，并给出准确的接车时间。

items.title: 说明乘车人数
items.prompt: How many passengers will there be?
items.hint: 说明乘客人数；如果有大件行李或特殊需求，也一并告诉司机。
